items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did he work with you? -- [INTERVIEWEE] You know Crowback, huh? No.

ctx.x: Ask him who Crowback worked with. Crowback? Yeah, Crowback.
Say, who did Crowback work with? The Dixon band. Yeah, he's from downtown Cleveland, you know.
